caveats: Arm B pins the excess to the star's measured (noisy) windowed centroid, so at high f_bg the centered excess inherits the uninjected centroid noise while the screen threshold assumes SNR_eff; centroid-screen Arm B false rejection is conservative (biased high) there
injection adds the empirical PSF without extra noise (W3 is background-limited; source shot noise neglected); real blends are extended or coloured, the injected ones are PSF-shaped point sources
the empirical PSF is aligned on noise-locked windowed centroids (shift-and-add), which sharpens a stacked PSF by ~1-3% at W3 SNR 8-20 (synthetic check); its FWHM is a slight underestimate

the image screen uses one scalar noise variance per cutout (median unc^2 in the fit region); Atlas pixel-noise correlation is absorbed by the median-matched Delta chi^2 scale fitted on calibration nulls, and the chi^2(3) tail shape is an assumption whose out-of-sample check is the withheld null false-alarm rate
calibration 'nulls' are isolated Gaia-clean M dwarfs; unseen W3 background sources among them are part of the realistic null, not removed
SNR_eff = w3snr / (1 - f_bg) assumes background-limited photometry of the blend
description: Public-Launch Gate #2: frozen-method blend screens on real AllWISE W3 Atlas cutouts of the 154 locked control stars. Empirical PSF and both thresholds frozen on the 77 calibration stars; withheld two-arm injection (off-center blends vs matched centered excess).

empirical_psf.construction: sky = median(r >= 16 px); Gate #1 windowed centroid (6.5" window); cubic-spline recentring; unit-sum 31x31 stamps; pixel-wise median; renormalised

fetch.service: NASA/IPAC IRSA IBE cutouts of the AllWISE Atlas coadd selected by the Gate #1 IRSA SIA query (locked control 'image' URL)

centroid.statistic: Gate #1 windowed W3 centroid offset from the Gaia position

image.scale_rule: s = median(Delta chi^2_cal) / median(chi2(3)); threshold = s * chi2.isf(FA, 3)
image.statistic: profile Delta chi^2, one empirical PSF (position prior N(Gaia, sigma_sys)) vs two (second flux >= 0); sky projected out; continuous refinement

naive_flux_excess.role: adversarial reference rule (NOT a proposed screen)
naive_flux_excess.rule: flux_ratio - 1 > 3 / SNR, flux_ratio = 1 + (aperture flux - uninjected aperture flux) / F_star, r <= 12 px

frozen_screens.snr_eff_rule: SNR_eff = w3snr / (1 - f_bg) (catalog sees the blended flux)

injection.arm_a: off-center blend at separation theta from the star's measured image centroid, seeded azimuth
injection.arm_b: matched centered excess: identical F_bg at theta = 0 (the star's measured image centroid)
injection.background_flux: F_bg = F_star f_bg / (1 - f_bg); F_star = PSF-fit flux of the uninjected star at its windowed centroid
injection.noise: none added (W3 is background-limited; source shot noise neglected)
injection.template: empirical PSF (calibration stars only), cubic spline

summary.survival_weighting: p(theta) ~ theta for theta <= 3.25 arcsec, uniform f_bg
